name: Image to mesh generator
summary: Photos to 3D meshes on an NVIDIA GPU: TripoSR (coloured), Hunyuan3D-2 mini (detailed shape) or Hunyuan3D-2 multi-view (front/left/back/right fused); GLB/OBJ/STL/PLY, shaded previews.
help: Start it from the Mesh Studio view: it sends the chosen pictures to this run at full quality (up to 1024 px). Or, for a run from the blueprint, give Image links (one per line) or wire pictures to Images and turn on Run without the View. Models: TripoSR (MIT, coloured mesh, seconds), Hunyuan3D-2 mini (detailed shape without colour, about 6 GB of GPU memory), Hunyuan3D-2 multi-view (pictures of one object from the front, left, back and right, named like chair_front.png, fused into one shape). Hunyuan3D-2 is under the Tencent Hunyuan Community licence, which does not cover the EU, the UK or South Korea. The model code is cloned once into the machine's cache and runs with its own library versions.

inputs.label: Images (optional)
inputs.help: Pictures for a run started from the blueprint (with Run without the View on)

outputs.label: Meshes (GLB)
outputs.help: One GLB per object: for the 3D view and downloads

params.label: Quality
params.help: TripoSR: surface resolution 192 / 256 / 320. Hunyuan3D-2: turbo 5 steps / 30 steps / 50 steps at a finer octree

params.label: Image links
params.help: One picture link per line, for a run from the blueprint

params.label: Run without the View
params.help: On: a blueprint Run generates from Image links / the Images input. Off: only the View's Generate meshes starts generation
